IC1: Capacity to provide informed consent before any trial-related activities
IC3: HbA1c = 9% [OR] if on triple therapy or = 10% on diet & exercise or monotherapy or dual therapy
IC4: Current glucose lowering therapy either mono, dual [OR]  or triple of any combination of metformin [OR], sulphonylurea [OR], DPP-IV inhibitor, [OR] GLP-1 therapy [OR] or an SGLT2 +/- diet [OR] and exercise
IC5: Poorly managed diet controlled diabetes (with HbA1c > 6.5% , [NOT] not currently taking any glucose lowering therapy, meeting BMI inclusion range)
IC6: Body mass index > 30Kg/m2 [OR] or > 27.5 Kg/m2 (South Asian),
IC7: Diagnosis of T2DM before the age of 60 years of age
